## What to remember {#revision-essentials}

- On a batch, the forward pass predicts, the loss compares predictions with targets, the backward pass computes gradients and the optimizer updates parameters.
- Teacher forcing uses observed tokens in training prefixes. During generation, the loop feeds back tokens it has selected.
- Validation measures the model on data held out from parameter updates. Falling training loss with sustained deterioration in validation warrants investigation.
- Validation can guide checkpoint selection or hyperparameter tuning. The final test set is reserved for evaluating the selected model.

## Recall from memory {#revision-check}

After computing the loss on a validation pass, should you call the optimizer?

<details>
<summary>Show the answer</summary>

No. The pass measures the current parameters without fitting them on validation data.

</details>
